unknown-facet.detail: The module names a facet that is not configured.

unknown-facet-value.title: Unknown facet value
unknown-facet-value.detail: The module names a value its facet does not have.

unknown-safety-symbol.detail: A safety notice uses a symbol that is not configured.

unknown-text-attribute.title: Unknown text attribute
unknown-text-attribute.detail: A text attribute is not configured.

placeholder-in-module.title: Placeholder in a module
placeholder-in-module.detail: A module holds a page design placeholder, which only a page design’s text may hold.

unknown-placeholder.title: Unknown placeholder
unknown-placeholder.detail: A placeholder names no known value.

unknown-variant-attribute.title: Unknown variant attribute
unknown-variant-attribute.detail: A condition or variant names an attribute that is not configured.

unknown-variant-value.title: Unknown variant value
unknown-variant-value.detail: A condition or variant names a value its attribute does not have.

version-compare-on-enum.title: Version comparison on a list
version-compare-on-enum.detail: A condition compares versions on an attribute that is not a version.

invalid-version-value.title: Invalid version
invalid-version-value.detail: A version attribute’s value is not a version.

missing-variant-attribute.title: Variant attribute not set
missing-variant-attribute.detail: A variant does not set an attribute a condition tests: the content under it is left out.

missing-text-attribute.title: Text attribute not set
missing-text-attribute.detail: A variant has no value for a text attribute the content uses.

pdf-accessibility.title: PDF not accessible
pdf-accessibility.detail: The PDF cannot meet PDF/UA-1, the accessible PDF standard: it is not created until this is fixed.

pdf-not-checked.title: PDF not checked
pdf-not-checked.detail: The PDF could not be created (it took too long, or the template has an error), so its accessibility (PDF/UA-1) was not checked. Open the PDF to see why.

pdf-layout-not-checked.title: Layout not checked
pdf-layout-not-checked.detail: The PDF could not be created (it took too long, or the template has an error), so what its page design’s layout cannot fit was not checked. Open the PDF to see why.

page-design-overflow.title: Page design text cut off
page-design-overflow.detail: A text of the page design does not fit its place on the title or back page, so the PDF cuts it off. Shorten the text in the design, or its translation.

running-head-truncated.title: Running head shortened
running-head-truncated.detail: A running header or footer does not fit on one line even at its smallest size, so the PDF shortens it with an ellipsis. Shorten the chapter title or the design’s header or footer text.

callout-label-overflow.title: Callout legend cut off
callout-label-overflow.detail: A callout’s legend beside its image does not fit the image’s height even at its smallest size, so the PDF cuts it off. Shorten the legend or its translation, put the legend below the image, or ask an administrator to lower the smallest size (pdf.calloutLabelMinSize in the configuration).

safety-message-split.title: Safety message split across pages
safety-message-split.detail: A safety message is taller than a whole page of the page design, so it cannot be kept on one page: the PDF breaks it across pages. Shorten the message or split it into several, or use a design with a larger page or smaller type.

page-design-missing-value.title: Page design value missing
page-design-missing-value.detail: A placeholder or title page field of the page design has no value for this manual and variant: the placeholder stays as it is, the field is left out. Give the manual the value, or take it out of the design.

page-design-missing-text-attribute.title: Page design text attribute missing
page-design-missing-text-attribute.detail: A text of the page design uses a text attribute this variant has no value for. Give the manual a value for it.

page-design-missing-variant-attribute.title: Page design condition unknown
page-design-missing-variant-attribute.detail: A condition in the page design tests a variant attribute this variant does not set, so what it holds is left out.

passthrough.title: Passthrough content
passthrough.detail: Kept as it was imported and printed unchecked: convert it to blocks.

empty-table.title: Empty table
empty-table.detail: Every cell of a table is empty: fill it in or remove it.

snippet-too-large.title: Snippet too large
snippet-too-large.detail: A snippet holds a section or a module reference: snippets are one or a few blocks of text.

inconsistent-variants.title: Inconsistent variants
inconsistent-variants.detail: The manual’s variants set different attributes.

above-audience.title: Above the manual’s audience
above-audience.detail: The module is meant for a narrower audience and is left out of the manual.

delivery-access-capped.title: Address access capped
delivery-access-capped.detail: The project opens its stable addresses further than this server allows, so they open only as far as the server allows.

missing-module.title: Missing module
missing-module.detail: Refers to a module that does not exist.

module-ref-unknown-block.title: Broken module reference
module-ref-unknown-block.detail: Includes one block of a module that does not exist in it.

expansion-too-large.title: Too large with its references
expansion-too-large.detail: Once its module references are included, this is too large (more than 500,000 content elements or 12,000,000 characters, or content nested more than 100 levels deep). A manual cannot be resolved, previewed or printed; a module is left out of the retrieval chunks that search and assistants read. Refer to fewer modules, over fewer paths, or nest them less deeply.

chunk-set-too-large.title: Chunks too large together
chunk-set-too-large.detail: The content of this revision is too large together for the retrieval chunks that search and assistants read: many modules each include a lot. Once released, it would have no chunks at all. This module expanded among the most: refer to fewer modules, over fewer paths.

chunks-not-checked.title: Chunks not checked
chunks-not-checked.detail: Checking the retrieval chunks of these modules took too much work, so from this module on they were not checked. The modules include a lot: refer to fewer modules, over fewer paths.

xref-unknown-module.title: Broken reference
xref-unknown-module.detail: Links to a module that does not exist.

xref-unknown-block.title: Broken reference
xref-unknown-block.detail: Links to a block that does not exist.

xref-outside-manual.title: Reference outside the manual
xref-outside-manual.detail: Links to a module that is not in this manual.

missing-image.title: Missing image
missing-image.detail: The image is not stored: upload it again or choose another.

missing-attachment.title: Missing attached file
missing-attachment.detail: The attached file is not stored: upload it again or choose another.

attachment-file-name.title: File name does not fit the file
attachment-file-name.detail: The attachment's file name has an extension that does not fit the stored file, or one that could run code: downloads ignore it. Give it the file's own extension.

missing-translation.title: Missing translation
missing-translation.detail: No translation into a target language: the manual shows the source language.

outdated-translation.title: Outdated translation
outdated-translation.detail: The source changed since this translation was made: some blocks need translating again.

missing-label.title: Missing output labels
missing-label.detail: No output labels in the manual’s language: English is used.

unknown-term.title: Unknown term
unknown-term.detail: A term link names a term that does not exist.

deprecated-term.title: Deprecated term
deprecated-term.detail: A term link names a term that is deprecated.

deprecated-module.title: Deprecated module
deprecated-module.detail: Includes a module that is deprecated.

unknown-replacement.title: Unknown replacement
unknown-replacement.detail: The replacement named for this deprecation does not exist.

address-taken.title: Address taken
address-taken.detail: A stable address of one manual is another manual’s ID, so that address opens the wrong manual. Change the slug or former address in the delivery settings.

unknown-callout.title: Unknown callout
unknown-callout.detail: A callout reference names an image or a callout that does not exist.

hidden-callout.title: Hidden callout
hidden-callout.detail: A callout reference names a callout this variant leaves out: it has no number here.

unknown-callout-style.title: Unknown callout style
unknown-callout-style.detail: A callout on an image names a style that is not configured.

unknown-page-design.title: Unknown page design
unknown-page-design.detail: The page design the manual is printed with does not exist: the built-in design is used.

page-design-missing-translation.title: Page design text not translated
page-design-missing-translation.detail: A text of the page design has no version in the manual’s language: the source language’s is used. Translate it in the design.

page-design-dropped-text.title: Page design text left out
page-design-dropped-text.detail: A text of the page design has a version neither in the manual’s language nor in the source language, so the PDF leaves it out. Add it in the source language in the design.

page-design-region-languages-differ.title: Page design translation differs
page-design-region-languages-differ.detail: A region of the page design has other blocks in the manual’s language than in the source language. Give its translation the same blocks.

page-design-missing-font.title: Page design font missing
page-design-missing-font.detail: A font file of the page design is not stored or is no font, so the PDF uses the standard font. Upload the font again in the design.

missing-cover-image.title: Cover image missing
missing-cover-image.detail: The cover image of the manual, or of a variant, is not stored or is no image, so the PDF goes without it. Choose the image again in the manual’s settings.

missing-cover-alt.title: Cover image without source text
missing-cover-alt.detail: The cover image’s alternative text has no version in the source language, which every other language falls back to. Write it in the manual’s settings.

unknown-cover-variant.title: Cover image for no variant
unknown-cover-variant.detail: The manual gives a cover image to a variant it does not build, or to one that has one already: it is never shown. Remove it in the manual’s settings.

unknown-source-manual.title: Source manual missing
unknown-source-manual.detail: The derived manual gathers its content from a manual that does not exist or cannot be read, so it holds only its own front and back matter. Name an existing manual as its source.

derived-source.title: Source is derived
derived-source.detail: The derived manual names a derived manual, or itself, as its source, so nothing is gathered. Name an assembled manual as its source.

no-gathered-types.title: No module types to gather
no-gathered-types.detail: The derived manual’s rule names no module types, and the configuration marks none as safety content, so nothing is gathered. Name the types in the rule, or mark the safety types in the settings.

safety-module-excluded.title: Safety module left out
safety-module-excluded.detail: A safety module of the source manual is not in the derived manual: its rule excludes it, or does not gather its type. Check that leaving it out is intended.

safety-notice-excluded.title: Safety notice left out
safety-notice-excluded.detail: A safety notice of the source manual is not in the derived manual: its rule leaves out every module that includes it, does not search their type, or does not gather its hazard level. Check that leaving it out is intended.

unknown-excluded-module.title: Excluded module not in the source
unknown-excluded-module.detail: The derived manual’s rule excludes a module that its source manual does not include. Remove it from the rule.

empty-derived-manual.title: Nothing gathered
empty-derived-manual.detail: The derived manual’s rule gathers no module from its source manual, so it holds only its own front and back matter.

derived-audience-wider.title: Wider audience than its source
derived-audience-wider.detail: The derived manual is for a wider audience than its source manual, so nothing is gathered from it: it holds only its own front and back matter. Give it the source’s audience or a narrower one, or gather from a manual for its audience.

missing-manufacturer.title: Manufacturer details missing
missing-manufacturer.detail: The project has no manufacturer details, so the manual would be released without its imprint. Add them in the project settings, under Manufacturer.

missing-source-title.title: Title without source text
missing-source-title.detail: The manual’s title, or a group’s, is written per language without a version in the source language, which every other language falls back to. Write it under Manuals.

page-design-template-error.title: Page design template does not compile
page-design-template-error.detail: The page design's own template has an error, so its PDF cannot be created. Fix the template's file at the line named; until the fix is merged, the released template stays in use.

page-design-unknown-template.title: Unknown page design template
page-design-unknown-template.detail: The page design names an own template the content repository does not have: its layout preset is used.

forbidden-term.title: Forbidden term
forbidden-term.detail: The text uses a forbidden variant of a term, or a deprecated term.

style-rule.title: Style rule
style-rule.detail: The text does not follow a rule of the house style.

writing-not-checked.title: Writing not checked
writing-not-checked.detail: The terminology and style checks stopped before the end of the module.

panel.title: Checks
panel.failed: The checks could not be read.

modulePicker.description: Find a module to reuse here, check it in the preview and choose how to insert it.
modulePicker.emptyDescription: Try other words or fewer filters.
modulePicker.chooseHint: Choose a module to see it here.
modulePicker.previewFailed: The module could not be loaded.
modulePicker.previewMissing: The module is not there, or not visible to you.
modulePicker.noText: This module has no text yet.

newModule.title: Start a module
newModule.body: A module is one topic, written once and used in any manual. New module asks for its title and type; you write it in a revision of your own.

preview.title: See it as it prints
preview.body: Preview shows the module beside what you write, laid out as in the PDF, for the variant you choose.

review.title: Your revisions and your reviews
review.body: Switch here between the revisions waiting for you and your own. Open one to see what changed, comment and approve it.

notifications.title: Hear back on your revisions
notifications.body: The bell tells you when a revision of yours is reviewed, returned, approved or merged.

content.title: Content
content.body: Every module is here, by language and type. Search and filter the list, and open a module to read or write it.

editor.title: The editor
editor.body: Opening a module opens the editor. What you write is saved as you type, into your revision: nothing reaches the published content until it has been reviewed.

changeSets.title: Revisions
changeSets.body: Every change goes into a revision, a draft of your own. Pick one here, or start one with your first edit.

review.title: Review
review.body: When your revision is ready, submit it here. Reviewers comment and approve it, and then it is merged into the published content.

search.title: Search
search.body: Press {keys} anywhere to find a module, a manual or a page of the user guide, and / to search the list on screen.
